text: A dynamic global shall remain ready during its completion callback, then become finalized on normal callback return. Later content access shall cause `global_finalized`; allocation/address formation shall remain available until termination. Callback naming shall grant no mutation rights to immutable contents. Other globals shall remain available until their own finalization or termination.
